title: 'Destiny Unchain Online' Reveals Main Cast, Staff, Teaser Promo, 2027 Debut
content:
An official website opened for the Destiny Unchain Online television anime on Friday, revealing the main cast, staff, a teaser visual (pictured), and teaser promotional video. The anime series adapting resn 's adventure fantasy light novel will premiere in 2027.

Voice actress Ikumi Hasegawa ( 86 , Bocchi the Rock! ) is starring as the main character Crim.

Staff Director: Kouichi Hatsumi ( Tokyo Revengers ) Series Composition: Seiko Takagi ( Yakusoku no Neverland script) Character Design: Masashi Kudou ( Kami no Tou ) Music: Yuuki Hayashi ( Boku no Hero Academia ), Yuki Furuhashi ( Vigilante: Boku no Hero Academia Illegals ), Hayato Studio: Voil

resn began penning the story on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in May 2020 before transferring it to the Kakuyomu website in June 2021. Kodansha began publishing the light novel under its K Ranobe Books label with illustrations by Yachimoto in November 2022. The third volume went on sale on June 2.

Yachimoto also began serializing a manga adaptation on the Magazine pocket platform in July 2022. Kodansha released the 13th volume on August 7.

Kodansha USA began simulpublishing the manga in English on its K Manga service on March 15.

Teaser PV

title: Yōko Hikasa, Yuka Iguchi Join Cast of Wound & Bandage Anime
content:
The official website for television anime of Umihoshi Nanai 's Wound & Bandage ( Kizuguchi to Hōtai ) manga streamed a third teaser promotional video on Friday, which reveals two new cast members.

The new cast includes Yōko Hikasa as Matsu Daemon (far left in above image) and Yuka Iguchi as Magical Penpengusa (far right in above image). The two characters are members of the "bandage alliance" internet community along with the protagonist Riyu Washizu (under the username Wamp Samurai). The "bandage alliance" gathers those who have a fetish of seeing strong people weakened.

The anime stars:

• Hisako Kanemoto as Riyo Washizu

• Chikahiro Kobayashi as Gō Kiritani

• Shōya Ishige as Ginsuke Hatobane

Miyuki Ishida ( I.Cinnamoroll , director, One Punch Man season 2 and 3 episode director) is directing the anime at J.C. Staff . Susumu Yamakawa ( The Way of the Househusband three seasons, Murai in Love ) is writing the scripts, and Natsuki Ōyama ( Can a Boy-Girl Friendship Survive? ) is designing the characters.

The romantic comedy centers on Riyo Washizu, the daughter of the leader of the yakuza organization that occupies the Kanto region of Japan. Gō Kiritani, a young subordinate in the organization, becomes Riyo's caretaker. He expects her to be just a docile child, but he soon learns that Riyo has a certain fetish — she loves seeing strong people when they are weak.

The manga debuted on Kodansha 's Comic Days app in August 2024. Kodansha shipped the fifth volume on July 16.
author: ANN

title: 'Kizuguchi to Houtai' Unveils Additional Cast, Third Teaser Promo
content:
The official website of the Kizuguchi to Houtai ( Wound and Bandage ) television anime unveiled additional cast, third teaser visual (pictured), and third promotional video on Friday. The anime series adapting Nanai Umihoshi 's romantic comedy manga will premiere on January 9, 2027 at 11:00 p.m. on AT-X, followed by ABC TV and TV Asahi on the ANiMAZiNG programming block.

Cast Ginsuke Hatobane: Shouya Ishige ( Sono Bisque Doll wa Koi wo Suru ) Magical Penpengusa: Yuka Iguchi ( Honzuki no Gekokujou ) Matsuda Emon: Youko Hikasa ( High School DxD )

Miyuki Ishida ( Danjo no Yuujou wa Seiritsu suru? (Iya, Shinai!!) assistant director) is helming the anime at J.C.Staff , with Susumu Yamakawa ( Gokushufudou series composition) penning the script. Natsuki Ooyama ( 2.5-jigen no Ririsa animation director) is designing the characters.

Umihoshi originally began the manga as a one-shot in Getsumaga Kichi magazine in February 2024. The manga began serializing in Comic Days magazine the following August. Kodansha published the fifth volume on July 16.

Teaser PV 3 (Comrades ver.)

title: Kadokawa Launches 'Kadokawa World Manga' English Label on its KadoComi Platform
content:
Kadokawa announced on Friday it has launched the " Kadokawa World Manga" label dedicated to English releases of ongoing manga series on its web manga platform KadoComi . The label is available here .

The label offers the opening and latest chapters of selected series for free in English for international audiences. Kadokawa stated it will add more titles over time to expand the lineup. The company also stated the label is also a publishing platform for " Kadokawa World Manga Atelier," the publisher's initiative "dedicating to discovering and supporting international creators to develop original works."

The launch lineup for the new label includes:

Jaki and Gamu launched the manga on KadoComi in Japanese on July 31, and Jaki had told ANN at the time the manga would get an English release this fall.

Indian manga creator duo masterlynx launched the manga in Japanese on KadoComi on May 15.

Ueno launched the manga in Japanese on KadoComi on February 27.

Kadokawa started offering the manga in English digitally on the BookWalker Global site and other retailers in February 2025. Yen Press licensed the series earlier this month for print release. Ueji launched the manga in Kadokawa 's Asuka magazine in July 2024.

The Kadokawa World Manga label page also features existing English manga such as Nikiichi Tobita 's Elden Ring: The Road to the Erdtree and Aki Shimizu 's Suikoden Star Leap .

title: Death Stranding Isolations Anime Reveals Teaser Trailer, More Staff
content:
Kojima Productions revealed on Friday a teaser video, visual, and more staff members for the Death Stranding Isolations anime series based in the universe of Hideo Kojima 's Death Stranding game.

Tow Ubukata ( Mardock Scramble and Bye Bye, Earth novels; scriptwriter for Ghost in the Shell Arise , Fafner , Psycho-Pass 2 ) is overseeing and writing the series scripts. Other newly revealed staff members include:

• Character Designer: Sayaka Koiso

• Color Script and Art Director: Yann Le Gall

• Color Designer: Ami Kutsuna

• 3D Department Manager: Tomohiko Kan

• Compositing Director: Jumi Lee

• Editor: Keisuke Yanagi, ACE

• Sound Director: Shūhei Abe

Kojima Productions has also revealed a new story synopsis for the anime:

“My mom became a crater.” The Death Stranding—a catastrophic series of explosions caused when the dead crept into our world and collided with the living. In the wake of this cataclysm, many were forced to live in absolute isolation—among them, a young girl. Although this lonely existence was forced upon her, she soon grows to prefer solitude, eschewing all opportunities for real human connection and allowing herself to be strung along by fate. In DEATH STRANDING, legendary game creator Hideo Kojima brought you a haunting vision of a shattered world. Now, that world expands into new frontiers with a brand-new animation series. Under the guidance of director Takayuki Sano , world-class hand-drawn animations have been brought to life by renowned studio “ E&H production ” ( NINJA KAMUI , BULLET/BULLET , the Magic Knight Rayearth television series). The story is set in North America immediately after Sam—the protagonist of the game—reconnects the continent by means of the Chiral Network. However, as America is reborn from the ashes, the renewed connections that bind it together bring about new and unforeseen consequences. In this tumultuous new landscape, there are some who walk a different path to the one chosen by Sam and his Bridges comrades: a wise old man who connects people through a method that defies all reckoning; a female soldier ensnared in a cycle of war and destruction; a boy who seethes with rage at the absurdity of his life...and of course, the girl who chose to sever all ties with the outside world...Fate has other plans for her, however, and chance encounters see her launched headfirst into a world she does not recognize.

The anime will debut on Disney+ or other Disney services in 2027.

Takayuki Sano ( Attack on Titan The Final Season and Attack on Titan The Final Season Part 2 episode animation director, Bullet/Bullet episode animation director) is directing the series at E&H production , with original character designs by illustrator Ilya Kuvshinov ( The Wonderland , Ghost in the Shell: SAC_2045 ). Hideo Kojima is the executive producer and Kojima Productions is producing the series.

Kojima reported in an interview with Vogue Japan in May 2025 that a Death Stranding animation was in the works.

The franchise is inspiring a separate animation feature film project with the working title DEATH STRANDING MOSQUITO . Hiroshi Miyamoto ( Eiga Precure Dream Stars! , Hugtto! Precure Futari wa Precure All Stars Memories ) is directing the project at ABC ANIMATION STUDIO . Kojima Productions and Line Mileage previously announced that Aaron Guzikowski ( Raised by Wolves ) is writing the project's script. The animation project will tell an original story.

The game is inspiring yet another separate film adaptation at Hammerstone Studios ( Barbarian, Bill and Ted Face the Music ). Director Michael Sarnoski ( Pig , A Quiet Place: Day One ) is set to write and direct the film. Lars Knudsen and Ari Aster's Square Peg production company is also producing the film.

The original Death Stranding game shipped for PlayStation 4 in November 2019. The game launched on PC via Steam in July 2020. Death Stranding: Director's Cut , the PlayStation 5 version of the game, launched in September 2021. Death Stranding: Director's Cut launched for PC via Steam and Epic Games Store in March 2022.

The Death Stranding 2: On the Beach sequel game launched for PlayStation 5 in June 2025, and for PC on March 19.

Kojima Productions established a new division in Los Angeles, California in 2021 dedicated to music, television, and film.
author: ANN

title: 'Death Stranding: Isolations' Reveals Additional Staff, Teaser Promo
content:
The official X of Kojima Productions revealed additional staff, teaser visual (pictured), and a teaser promotional video for the Death Stranding: Isolations anime series on Friday. The anime is scheduled to premiere worldwide on the Disney+ streaming service in 2027.

Staff Series Composition, Script: Tow Ubukata ( RWBY: Hyousetsu Teikoku ) Character Design: Sayaka Koiso ( Jujutsu Kaisen 2nd Season ) Art Director, Color Script: Yann Le Gall ( Ramen Akaneko ) Color Design: Ami Kutsuna ( The God of High School ) 3D Department Manager: Tomohiko Kan ( Undead Girl Murder Farce CG director) Director of Photography: Ju-mi Lee ( Ninja Kamui ) Editing: Keisuke Yanagi ( Ranma ½ (2024) ) Sound Director: Shuuhei Abe ( Isekai Nonbiri Nouka )

Takayuki Sano ( Magic Knight Rayearth (2026) assistant director) directs at E&H Production . Ilya Kuvshinov ( Koukaku Kidoutai: SAC_2045 ) drafted the original character designs.

Developed by Kojima Productions, with publishing by Sony Interactive Entertainment for PlayStation consoles and 505 Games for other platforms, Death Stranding released on PlayStation 4 in November 2019, followed by Windows in July 2020, PlayStation 5 in September 2021, iOS, iPadOS, and macOS in January 2024, and Amazon Luna and Xbox Series X/S in November 2024. Death Stranding sold a cumulative 5 million copies worldwide by July 2021 and reached over 20 million players worldwide by April 2025.

The video game is also being adapted into an anime movie tentatively titled Death Stranding Mosquito at ABC Animation Studio .

Teaser Promo

title: 3 Anime to Watch If You Miss Fire Force
content:
Based on Atsushi Ookubo’s action Shonen manga, Fire Force remains one of the most beloved action fantasy series of all time. While the manga was released in 2019, the series took four years to release an anime adaptation by David Production. However, the wait was more than worth it thanks to the intriguing story praised for its unique world-building in a post-apocalyptic era, thrilling action, and, most of all, one of the most satisfying endings in Shonen. The manga reached its conclusion in 2022, and it set a benchmark for Shonen endings, especially considering how the demographic is infamous for rushed and controversial finales.

In April this year, the anime adaptation also wrapped up the main story, which did justice to the absurd visuals featured in the manga. The anime ends after a major time skip featuring how Shinra and the others have adjusted to the new world. Since the franchise already has a prequel titled Soul Eater , we can’t expect to see much from the main characters of Fire Force in the future. Not to mention that both manga by Ookubo have already ended without any extra chapters or continuation. Since Fire Force is over for good, you can watch these three anime to fill the void.

3) Soul Eater

As mentioned earlier, Fire Force was released as a sequel to Soul Eater to explain the reason how that bizarre world came into existence. It follows different characters from Fire Force while exploring the new world created by Shinra in the Fire Force ending. After the second Great Cataclysm, Shinra reconstructed the world from scratch after everyone was incinerated and the planet was turned into a second sun. In order to break the cycle of despair and ensure that another Cataclysm wouldn’t happen, Shinra made life a little less precious. In the new world he created, Death is something everyone is familiar with, which makes the premise of Soul Eater all the more unique. This anime was adapted by Studio Bones, and it never returned with a sequel season, but it’s still a must-watch for every Fire Force fan. While the Fire Force finale teased a Soul Eater anime , it’s unclear if the anime will return with a sequel or a reboot next.

2) My Hero Academia

On the surface, it may not seem like both series have anything in common. However, the narratives are driven by the intense desire of Shinra and Deku to become heroes. While Shinra wishes to be a hero so he could finally be accepted by the world, Izuku’s wish is to follow in the footsteps of his idol, All Might. My Hero Academia follows similar Shonen tropes such as a shadowy villain organization, powers given to a select few in the world by pure luck, and many more things that will remind you of Fire Force . Not only that, but this exceptional series has also been fully adapted into an anime , which makes ot even easier for fans to catch up with the series. Written and illustrated by Kohei Horikoshi, MHA is considered no less than a Shonen classic, all thanks to its global influence and popularity.

1) Blue Exorcist

The manga has been ongoing since 2009, and thanks to its huge fan base, the anime keeps returning with sequels. While Blue Exorcist is yet another series with a different premise, it shares similarities through the protagonist. Both protagonists are feared as Devils, but they turn out to be innocent teenagers with heartwarming personalities that make everyone around them root for them. Not to mention that they start off as powerful, so unlike My Hero Academia , we don’t get to see the underdog trope. While Fire Force relies heavily on world-building and layers of mysteries, Blue Exorcist comes off as more slice-of-life with an action-driven narrative. The latest season, Blue Exorcist: Shimane Illuminati Saga , was released in 2024, but a sequel might take longer than expected since the manga runs on a monthly schedule. This is why it will take a while before enough chapters are released for the animation studio to release a new season.

Do you agree with our picks – or have an anime you’d like to recommend that shares similar vibes to Fire Force ? Let us know in the comments below.

title: Crunchyroll Kicks Off English Dub for Fall 2026’s Darkest Romance
content:
The English dub of Firefly Wedding is finally streaming on Crunchyroll, although there has been a delay. It’s one of the biggest anime series of the Fall 2026 lineup, and also the darkest romance fans have been introduced to in a while. The manga, written and illustrated by Oreco Tachibana, was already a major hit, and the anime’s popularity continues to rise thanks to its exceptional storytelling, stunning visuals, and a unique premise. Following the hit anime premiere on October 9th, the English dub episodes began streaming two weeks later on October 23rd, 2026. The official website of Crunchyroll confirms the update with the cast and crew of the English dub.

Additionally, the anime has only released one episode in English dub while the subbed version already has three episodes. The English dub will be delayed for two weeks throughout its run. Crunchyroll will keep releasing new dubbed episodes each week along with the official release of upcoming episodes. The anime streams new episodes every Friday at 9:00 A.M. PT, shortly after the Japanese broadcast. Additionally, it’s available across North America, Central America, South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East, CIS, and the Indian Subcontinent.

Firefly Wedding Live-Action Is Already in the Works

Less than a week after the anime’s debut, Firefly Wedding also confirmed its live-action adaptation . The information was shared by Comic Natalie along with a region-locked promotional video. Only fans in Japan have been able to watch the first glimpse at the live-action adaptation, which is why it’s impossible to determine how this version of the story will turn out. While most of the details are currently unknown, the live-action drama will be released next year. Additionally, it’s being produced by Fuji TV which which is all the more reason to look forward to this adaptation. Unfortunately, there’s little to no guarantee that international fans will be able to stream it anytime soon after its release. Live-action adaptations, especially dramas, are mostly released for fans in Japan, which makes it difficult for fans to watch them. Not only are those dramas rarely available on streaming websites, but it’s also difficult to attain their subbed and dubbed versions.

Firefly Wedding Anime Is a Must-Watch Despite the Manga Controversy

While the manga was loved among fans throughout its run, the same can’t be said about the finale. The manga began serialization on Shogakukan’s MangaONE platform in January 2023 and reached its conclusion exactly three years later in January this year. Without spoiling anything from the manga, all we can say is that the ending was met with heavy criticism for several reasons. However, despite that, the series will be worth your while thanks to its historical setting and the unique relationship between the protagonists. The story centers around Satoko, the daughter of an esteemed noble family with a heart ailment that will soon take her life. Despite that, she wishes to marry someone suitable to ease her father’s worries. However, her life takes a drastic turn when she is kidnapped and has no choice but to pretend she fell in love with the mysterious assassin who orchestrated it. What begins as Satoko’s desperate attempt to save herself soon turns into a dangerous obsession for the assassin, Shinpei Goto.

title: Bleach Creator Returns With Closer Look at New Characters Revealed in Anime Finale
content:
More than 22 years after the anime debut, Bleach has finally reached its conclusion with the fourth part of the Thousand-Year Blood War Arc. As one of the most iconic Shonen Jump series of all time, the series took longer than expected to adapt the entire manga, but the wait was more than worth it. The anime released its final part in July this year as part of the Summer 2026 lineup and reached its conclusion after a major delay. As part of the Shonen Big Three alongside One Piece and Naruto, Bleach has always been celebrated as one of the most beloved Shonen Jump anime and manga franchises of all time.

However, despite the franchise’s popularity and the manga ending, it took Pierrot around a decade to return with a sequel to adapt the Thousand-Year Blood War Arc . The final arc of the main story was split into four parts, and it returned with far better quality animation, pacing, and original scenes. Tite Kubo, the manga creator, was heavily invested in the production by providing original character designs and storyboards for the anime’s final arc. The anime briefly introduced two new characters in the finale as well, whose information was shared by the creator along with the finale broadcast.

Bleach Creator Shares Information on Two Original Characters

The official X handle of Tite Kubo shared the character designs and concept sketches of Chad’s trainer and opponent for the finale. The update was shared around the same time as the finale broadcast . Introducing new but minor characters in the anime isn’t new in the TYBW arc, and Kubo is responsible for all of them. The sketches shared by the official handle are also drawn by the creator. The new designs may not be about characters with major roles in the story, but they help add more depth to Chad’s character. In the finale, Chad is introduced as a professional boxer, which is why these background characters are crucial to his backstory. Interestingly enough, his opponent shares a hilarious resemblance to a bald Yhwach.

What’s Next for Bleach After Anime Finale?

While the anime has already reached its conclusion, this doesn’t mean the end of the franchise. Studio Pierrot also needs to adapt the one-shot Kubo released in 2021 as part of the manga’s 20th anniversary. Titled No Breathes From Hell , the one-shot manga opened room for the story’s expansion, as it shed more light on Ichigo’s future and those around him. However, even if the manga didn’t expand the story completely with a longer run, there’s still a high possibility that the one-shot will be adapted into an anime, which will be just as exciting. Additionally, Bleach will be holding a panel on the Jump Studio stage of Jump Festa 2027. The convention will be held on December 19th and 20th, 2026, where we can expect major announcements from most of the Shonen Jump hits. This also includes Bleach since it’s guaranteed to drop information on its upcoming projects, although the details won’t be announced before the convention.

title: Solo Leveling’s New Story Brings Back Jinwoo’s Most Tragic Ally
content:
Warning: This article contains spoilers from the Solo Leveling webtoon! While the upcoming Solo Leveling movie has yet to share information on its release window, the action role-playing game continues to drop brand new content for fans. The second season of the anime ended after adapting the Jeju Island Arc, one of the most beloved parts of the story. However, now that Jinwoo’s true powers are known to everyone in the world, things will only continue to get more intense from here on out. The anime wrapped up its second season in March last year, but it has yet to return with a new sequel.

On the other hand, Solo Leveling: Arise , the action role-playing game developed by Netmarble, continues to introduce new and original characters from the main story. While a lot of the playable characters are unique to the game, many more are based on the original story by Chugong. The game also expands on their backstories that were never included in the main story, which makes it all the more interesting. The official website has a dedicated page called Hunter Origin that shares those backstories in the form of a one-shot webtoon series, and the latest one centers around Go Gunhee, the Chairman of the Korean Hunters Association, who met a tragic end.

Solo Leveling: Arise Reveals a Brand New Backstory of Go Gunhee

Go Gunhee plays a crucial role in the main story as the Chairman and also one of Jinwoo’s closest allies. As an S-Rank Hunter , he also acts as a political and moral anchor to stop Hunters from abusing their powers. He is one of the few characters who recognized Jinwoo’s potential early on and supported him throughout the story. However, while Gunhee was one of the major characters of the story, his past was only ever briefly mentioned. Hunter Origin finally explains it in detail, starting from his childhood to his old age when he awakened as a Hunter and got a stronger body, just like a young man.

It also reveals how the ghosts of those he failed to protect have been following him throughout these years. Being a Hunter is a rewarding job, but the death toll is far greater than anything else. In order to not only protect the innocent citizens who are victims of dungeon breaks, but also the Hunters who raid those dungeons, Gunhee established the Korean Hunters Association. He used his money and influence to save as many lives as possible, which is one of the reasons why Jinwoo held such deep respect for him. However, after living a life of helping others, Gunhee met a tragic end at the hands of the Monarchs. Despite his powers, Jinwoo was unable to save him, which remained one of his biggest regrets in life.

What Will Happen in Solo Leveling Movie?

While the movie hasn’t shared any details regarding its release, it shared a concept video and a key visual in July this year at the time of its official announcement. This is the first feature-length movie of the anime , which will continue the story from where the second season left off. The anime wrapped up its latest season with a huge cliffhanger by introducing two Monarchs who are planning to cause chaos in the world. Not only that, but Things have taken a drastic turn after the Jeju Island Arc, now that the entire world is aware of what Jinwoo is truly capable of. Guilds from around the world are looking to recruit him, but there’s no doubt Jinwoo has plans of his own. We can expect the upcoming movie to adapt the Recruitment Arc and Ahjin Guild Arcs from the main story. Depending on the pacing and the runtime, we might even get a glimpse at the Double Dungeon Arc, which is a major turning point in the series.

What are your expectations for the upcoming Solo Leveling movie? And are you looking forward to seeing more from Go Gunhee in the future? Share your thoughts in the comments below.
